summary: Full end-to-end QA pass executed for Fintracker. Ran existing 10 pytest modules in batches. ~119 backend tests PASSED including investments CRUD/dashboard/transactions (8/8), reminders advanced+state transitions (6/6) which validates the recently-fixed smart-complete-on-recurring (datetime-from-string parse) bug, MPIN setup/verify/lockout, fintracker accounts/income/expense/bills/budgets/dashboards/transfers (27/27), transfers (14/14 after stale-test fix), snapshots (13/13 after stale-test fix), and multi-record persistence core. Frontend boots cleanly — homepage renders 4 module cards (Net Worth, Investments, Accounts, Reminders) + Get Started/Create Account CTAs; /investments page renders Total Investment Value / Total Invested / Total Gain-Loss cards + Investment Categories + Add Investment button. Firestore daily-read quota was exhausted during the latter half of the run (confirmed via backend.err.log: 'google.api_core.exceptions.ResourceExhausted: 429 Quota exceeded'), which caused all subsequent /api/auth/single-user, /api/recovery/*, and /api/upload/labels DB-touching requests to return 500. This is ENVIRONMENTAL per the brief — retry after 24h.

minor.issue: Returns 500 after Firestore daily-read quota exceeded (ResourceExhausted 429 from Google). Environmental — not a code bug. Retry after quota resets in 24h.

integration_issues.issue: When Firestore quota is exhausted, auto-bootstrap via useSingleUserMode() shows 'Not authenticated' banner on /investments. Environmental.

action_items: Wait for Firestore daily-read quota to reset (~24h) and re-run test_recovery_api.py + test_uploads_and_labels.py to confirm those 10 failures are purely environmental.

Consider raising Firebase project read quota or implementing aggressive backend-side result caching to avoid Firestore reads on every auth bootstrap (each pytest run currently issues 100s of find_one calls).
Monitor frontend 'Not authenticated' state: ensure a user-friendly retry CTA appears when auth bootstrap fails (currently silent red banner).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:803 single_user_mode() does a DB find_one on every call — high quota cost. Add an in-memory user-id cache (5–10 min TTL) keyed on email to dramatically reduce Firestore reads.

Backend hard-fails (500) when Firestore quota is hit. Wrap firebase_config.py find_one/find/insert with a try/except google.api_core.exceptions.ResourceExhausted and surface as HTTP 503 with a friendly 'service temporarily busy' message so the frontend can show a proper retry UI.

test_transfers_api.py, test_snapshots_api.py, test_multirecord_and_deltas.py, test_uploads_and_labels.py, test_recovery_api.py all had stale bank-account fixtures missing account_holder_name/account_number/ifsc_code (Session-8 validation). Fixed in this iteration but main agent should audit all future test factories for the new required fields.
Reminder smart-complete fix at reminders.py:~244 (parse string reminder_date before _next_occurrence) verified working — monthly/quarterly/yearly recurring all advance correctly.

success_rate.backend: ~92% (119 passed / ~129 total; 10 failures are Firestore-quota environmental, not code bugs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (boots, routes work, UI structure correct)

Bank-account validation tests in test_transfers/snapshots/multirecord/uploads/recovery were updated this iteration with account_holder_name+account_number+ifsc_code helpers — DO NOT roll back. Firestore quota is exhausted as of 2026-05-12 ~19:16 UTC; wait until next day for /api/auth/single-user to work again for live smoke tests. All test JUnit XMLs are saved in /app/test_reports/pytest/iter20_*.xml.
rca of the issue: 10 backend test failures (recovery 6 + uploads 4) failed with 500 'Internal Server Error'. Backend log shows google.api_core.exceptions.ResourceExhausted: 429 Quota exceeded from firebase_config.py:282 inside single_user_mode() handler. Root cause: Firebase Firestore project daily-read free-tier quota exhausted from cumulative test runs across iterations 1-20. Reproduction: any DB-touching request returns 500 once quota hits. Mitigation: (a) wait 24h for quota reset, (b) add user-id memoization cache in server.py single_user_mode(), (c) wrap Firestore wrapper calls with ResourceExhausted → 503 mapping so frontend can show retry UI rather than crashing.
